searchQuery: Remote Analyst roles — RevOps Analyst, GTM Operations Analyst, Sales Strategy Analyst, Marketing Ops Analyst, Business Ops Analyst — pivot from sales to operations/analytics

results.title: GTM Operations Analyst (Partnerships and Sales)
results.description: Operational backbone of the Partnerships and Sales teams. Drive efficiency, automation, and data-driven decision making across the sales cycle. Fully remote, flexible hours. Annual bonus potential, equity participation, and benefits.
results.notes: Strong analyst match for sales-to-ops pivot. GTM Ops Analyst title is ideal. Open-source data science company, well-funded. Deadline approaching 04/24. Automation focus aligns with Clay.com/OpenClaw experience.

results.title: RevOps Analyst
results.description: Revenue Operations Analyst supporting sales, marketing, and CS teams. Focus on CRM optimization, pipeline reporting, and process improvement. Total comp includes variable bonus and equity.
results.notes: Direct RevOps Analyst title — perfect pivot role. impact.com is a martech/SaaS company (target industry). Base meets threshold plus bonus and RSU upside. CRM and pipeline focus matches Perry's strengths.

results.title: GTM Operations Analyst
results.description: Optimize processes, analyze data, and provide actionable insights to support GTM strategy. Work closely with sales, marketing, customer success, operations, and leadership. Paddle offers unlimited holidays, stock options, private healthcare.
results.notes: Fintech SaaS (payments infrastructure) — target industry. GTM Ops Analyst is the exact pivot role. Data-driven insights focus. Strong benefits including equity. Comp likely competitive based on Paddle's pay bands.

results.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
results.description: Collaborate with sales, customer success, and marketing teams to optimize revenue operations processes and ensure data quality. Remote-first SaaS company. Location-independent pay. 4.6/5 employee rating on comp/benefits.
results.notes: RevOps Analyst at a high-growth data/martech SaaS company. Salary tops out at $100K but equity and culture are strong. Greenhouse ATS. Great brand for resume building in RevOps.

results.title: Senior RevOps Analyst
results.description: Transform marketing and revenue data into strategic insights. Develop dashboards and KPIs. Optimize marketing technology tools and integrations. Requires proficiency in HubSpot/Marketo and BI tools (Tableau, Looker, PowerBI). 100% remote company.
results.notes: Senior Analyst title is a step up. Marketing + revenue data focus. HubSpot proficiency required — aligns with Perry's skills. SaaS company. Equity included. Good for someone pivoting into deeper analytics.

results.title: Sales Strategy Analyst (Emerging Sales)
results.description: Join Emerging Sales Strategy team as strategic partner and infrastructure builder. 0→1 environment: build foundational reporting, define processes, and deliver insights. Public company (NYSE: IOT), high-growth IoT SaaS. Strong total comp with performance bonus and equity.
results.notes: Sales Strategy Analyst is a great pivot title. 0→1 builder role = high impact. Public SaaS company with strong total comp when factoring bonus + equity. Base starts low but total comp likely $100K+. IoT not a target industry but top-tier employer.

results.title: Senior Analyst, GTM Strategy & Operations
results.salaryRange: ~$100,000 - $140,000 (estimated from General Catalyst portfolio comp data)
results.description: Tackle complex cross-functional initiatives across Sales, Customer Success, Demand Gen, BizTech, and Finance. General Catalyst-backed AI company. 5+ years in GTM Strategy, Sales Ops, consulting, or strategic generalist roles in SaaS/B2B.
results.notes: AI-powered CX platform — hot sector. General Catalyst-backed. Senior Analyst in GTM Strategy is an ideal pivot role. Cross-functional scope matches Perry's experience. West Coast hours fine for LA.

results.title: Revenue Operations Analyst (RevOps Analyst)
results.description: Support revenue teams by managing data requests, troubleshooting workflows, and ensuring systems integrity. Refine performance metrics and dashboards. Healthtech company. Unlimited PTO, Summer Fridays, remote-first.
results.notes: RevOps Analyst at a healthtech company (target industry). Greenhouse ATS. Remote-first culture with great perks. Salary may land near threshold. Good fit for someone building RevOps chops.

results.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
results.description: Serve as the critical link between business teams and operational functions. Ensure alignment, data accuracy, and process efficiency across sales, marketing, and customer success. B2B SaaS healthtech company (brain health assessments).
results.notes: HealthTech SaaS (target industry). Growth-stage B2B company. RevOps Analyst role is an ideal pivot title. Salary may be below threshold but worth applying — cross-functional alignment focus plays to Perry's strengths.

results.title: Lead Sales & Growth Operations Analyst
results.description: Sales and growth operations analytics. Focus on pipeline analytics, sales efficiency, and growth metrics. Healthtech SaaS. Sits at the intersection of Sales, Growth, and Revenue. Different role from the Marketing & Growth Operations Analyst also listed at Tebra.
results.notes: Separate Tebra listing from the existing Marketing & Growth one. Sales-focused analyst role — ideal for sales-to-ops pivot. Top-tier comp ($127K-$145K). Healthtech SaaS (target industry). Greenhouse ATS.
